posthog:site-events.note: checked allowlist via payload.name in lib/analytics.ts; cookieless canonical-only

ledger:local-usage.note: on-device canonical usage ledger; uploads are derived frames

sync:usage-upload.note: enrolled upload of canonical frames to usage.aicharts.io

service:usage-days-read.note: hosted usage-days proxy; server enforces account scoping

vercel:usage-days-diagnostic.note: One fixed-shape terminal diagnostic per private-days request in provider-managed Vercel runtime logs. The application has no telemetry queue or store and makes no TTL/deletion guarantee. Fixed outcome enums, request-stage booleans and bounded HTTP status only; no identifiers, credentials, headers, URLs, query dates, raw errors, response bodies or usage counts. Sink failure cannot affect the public result.

route:/api/usage/pairing/start.note: dynamic route; per-request compute, no storage

route:/api/usage/pairing.note: dynamic route; per-request compute, no storage

route:/api/usage/consent.note: dynamic route; per-request compute, no storage

route:/api/usage/days.note: dynamic route; per-request compute, no storage

route:/api/usage/account.note: Private no-store account ID projection from one request-owned live Accounts read; no Worker request, credentials, profile details or product storage. Bounded browser renewal uses the existing suite-auth route.

route:/api/leaderboard.note: dynamic route; per-request compute, no storage

route:/api/suite-auth/[...path].note: Dynamic route; per-request compute, no product storage. Usage read recovery uses the pinned Accounts SDK with at most two same-origin session GETs and one refresh POST per failed read, within the existing browser request deadline; publishing mutations are never replayed.

route:/api/usage/stats.note: Authenticated detailed stats; account identity from server session; 366-day range; 8192 rows and 4 MiB response, refusal without truncation.

service:usage-stats-v2.note: Bounded native snapshot/status and private query endpoints using existing enrollment and restore authority; max 4 MiB upload.

durable-object:usage_stats_control.note: Numeric account projection control, canonical client writer ownership, settled idempotency receipts, or one pending immutable-object intent. Preserved under existing account lifecycle and restore fencing.

durable-object:usage_stats_writers.note: Numeric account projection control, canonical client writer ownership, settled idempotency receipts, or one pending immutable-object intent. Preserved under existing account lifecycle and restore fencing.

durable-object:usage_stats_devices.note: Numeric account projection control, canonical client writer ownership, settled idempotency receipts, or one pending immutable-object intent. Preserved under existing account lifecycle and restore fencing.

durable-object:usage_stats_pending.note: Numeric account projection control, canonical client writer ownership, settled idempotency receipts, or one pending immutable-object intent. Preserved under existing account lifecycle and restore fencing.

durable-object:usage_stats_days.note: Rebuildable numeric daily projections; explicit replacement windows exclude overlapping v1 totals.

r2:usage-stats-v2-snapshots.note: Existing private R2 bucket; content-addressed numeric snapshots and immutable receipts. SQL references distinguish committed receipts from abandoned intents; no source transcripts or credentials.

local:usage-source-cache.note: Private numeric provider history, explicit credential scope; complete atomic snapshots retain last good data. Explicit retirement only, not automatic eviction.

local:usage-stats-checkpoint.note: Existing private APFS enrollment: authenticated current/staged numeric flight and stable lock. Uncertain writes retain exact request; never delete to recover.

local:usage-import-snapshots.note: Private0700/0600 bounded scan snapshots; logical source bytes are capped. macOS clones share unchanged data blocks; fallback copies require a 2 GiB free-space reserve. Removed on normal success/error/unwind. Abrupt kill can leave an owned temporary directory requiring guarded cleanup.

local:usage-autosubmit-runtime.source: qualified native publication and provider refresh results
local:usage-autosubmit-runtime.note: Private stable cycle lock and latest numeric/fixed-code result only; no source content or credentials; config16KiB,54clients,30minute between-operation deadline.

local:usage-mcode-capture.note: Explicit user-requested process capture; only complete numeric observations retained, private cache bound to executable identity. Raw streams remain in bounded memory and are never persisted or echoed.

durable-object:fence_attempt.note: Per-execution restore grant/cancellation/settlement authority. Terminal attempts remain retained across delayed RPCs, credential replay and account restoration. No time-only expiry or reclamation. One million is the admission row cap, not an attested physical SQL/index/WAL byte bound; existing attempt reconciliation must remain available at capacity.

durable-object:usage_stats_day_sources.note: Canonical client/day writer provenance and ownership revision survive writer transfer. No foreign-owner replacement without exact population proof. Retained while its canonical day exists; no independent reclamation in this phase. Row bound is enforced, not an attested physical SQL/index/WAL byte budget.
